reports.title: Extradition petition para kay Quiboloy, malapit nang ihain — DOJ
reports.description:
#philstarnews #apolloquiboloy 

'WE'RE ALMOST READY TO FILE THAT PETITION'

Malapit nang ihain ang extradition petition para kay Kingdom of Jesus Christ founder Apollo Quiboloy, ayon kay Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida.

"We're in the final stages already of the vetting. Nagle-legal scrubbing na lang kami. We're almost ready to file that petition," ani Vida sa press briefing ngayong Huwebes, Oct. 1.

Pormal na hiniling ng United States ang extradition ni Quiboloy noong Agosto kaugnay ng federal indictment laban sa kanya noong 2021 sa California.
